title: SuperTag ContextSet manifest
description: A ContextSet manifest, as supertag apply -f reads it. Its spec is supertag.operator.v1.ContextSetSpec in supertag/operator/v1/resource.proto; this file is generated from it.

name.description: The resource's name, unique within its kind.

ContextSetSpec.description: A Context Set's declared items, and the `spec` of a `ContextSet` manifest. Apply merges items by `item_key`.

ContextItem.description: One Context Item: content a Worker resolver brings into a Task.

itemKey.description: Its stable key within the set, which makes applying it idempotent.

type.description: The Context Item contract, such as `supertag/skill`.

required.description: A required item fails closed when no compatible Worker resolver is available.

config.description: Settings the resolver reads. Never secret.
